title: settling-quiescence
description: The condition that a settling sequence has stabilized at an ordinal step: from a stabilization index onward, no predicate's value changes within the settling bound.

settling.description: the predication settling v = (v_tau)_{tau < lambda} this condition qualifies

stabilizationIndex.description: the ordinal step tau* at and after which the settling no longer changes (tau* < lambda)

quiescent.description: for every predicate p and every tau with tau* <= tau < lambda, v_tau(p) = v_{tau*}(p)
